evidence_scope: Contract manifest only. No desktop adapter source exists on the evidence baseline.

model.evidence: A llama.cpp-compatible local adapter is specified but not implemented.

memory.evidence: A user-controlled SQLite/RAG adapter is specified but not implemented.

voice.evidence: Offline voice components and privacy controls are specified but not implemented.

avatar.evidence: A software/OpenGL renderer and compact pack runtime are specified but not implemented.

device.evidence: Only public Linux/ChromeOS APIs will be exposed; no adapter exists.

notification.evidence: Desktop notification support is specified but not implemented.

storage.evidence: Local user-scoped storage is specified but not implemented.

process.evidence: Any process support must use fixed allowlists through the single control plane; no adapter exists.

network.evidence: Explicit opt-in network support is specified but not implemented.

presentation.evidence: Windowed, tray, and supported background modes are specified but not implemented.
